items.heading: Ncahp Has Formally Recommended Dropping
items.text: NCAHP has formally recommended dropping the word "paramedical" in favour of "Allied and Healthcare.".

items.heading: Colleges Are Gradually Renaming Departments
items.text: Colleges are gradually renaming departments and courses to match, do not be confused if a course is now listed as "B.Sc Allied Health Sciences" rather than "Paramedical.".

items.heading: The Underlying Course Content
items.text: The underlying course content and career scope are the same; the regulatory label changed, not the profession.
